name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Hörfinghof
beschreibung: The Hörfinghof in Kufstein is a working agricultural estate offering holiday apartments. The accommodation features a private bathroom and a well-equipped kitchen. Located within the municipal area of Kufstein, the town centre and historic fortress can be reached quickly and easily. High-quality farm produce is crafted right on site. The area surrounding Kufstein is rich in scenic hiking and cycling trails. The nearby Kaisergebirge mountain range invites outdoor enthusiasts on alpine tours. In addition, Kufstein serves as a major transport hub with excellent railway connections.
